parts.t: Ladner Rural has farmland, big acreages and quiet country homes. Browse the properties for sale below, and contact me with questions about acreage.
Ladner Rural is the farmland around Ladner. You'll find hobby farms, bigger working farms and country homes on acreage. Many properties have barns or other outbuildings.
